invariants: station.json requires owner permission
human-designed topology/dependencies/display
server-authoritative multiplayer simulation
same core in offline singleplayer
AI neighbours only in singleplayer
advanced AI after infrastructure gate
Each post has its own logically separate interlocking computer module; LCS aggregates but never merges KZ state.
Relinquishing post control preserves LCS dispatcher view access while revoking all control authority for that post.
Each logical post KZ has two computing groups, active and hot standby, on the authoritative host.
One fenced selector commits each logical effect once; group calculations never directly mutate physical terrain.
EBILock sets, internal dual channels, EBISCREEN servers and physical host HA are distinct.

Traffic AI is an in-house data-driven rule/state-machine/planning algorithm. LLMs are excluded from operational decisions, procedural replies and fallback execution in both multiplayer and offline singleplayer.
Interlocking domain logic is implemented in Ada; C#/.NET remains the client, host, terrain, movement and services.
Two independent Ada implementations Kz_A and Kz_B are authored in separate future chats from a frozen common specification without reading or copying each other.
Each hardware-style group 1/2 runs both independent A/B channels; four private dynamic contexts and one physical world.
At server-world startup, select the active group randomly per logical KZ only after readiness; record the choice. Replay reuses it and reconnect/lease changes never reroll.
Full admin panel S18 and supervisory dispatch mode S19 are final stages; minimum S08 moderation precedes the public pilot.
Admin desktop is not a secret: require device key AND account AND current rights. Password alone cannot enroll or recover admin access.

Owner-confirmed: administrator private keys are generated locally on administrator devices; server receives public keys and issues certificates, never generating, delivering or storing administrator private keys.
Each new module provides bounded structured logging through a module adapter; Ada emits passive diagnostics through its result, never direct filesystem/network I/O during evaluation.
Each execution chat handles one bounded job with declared dependencies, source/specification hashes, evidence and an explicit handoff. A and B keep separate authoring lineages.
Final documentation copies to D:/Projects/SUK are explicitly owner-authorized; no code edits, commit, index, push or deployment are authorized.
